messages:
Avery (finance): Heads-up: procurement/card update for Q2  please read. TL;DR: p-card single-charge cap moves to $1,200; all recurring subscriptions > $75/mo must be entered in the procurement intake; vendor onboarding lead time estimate now 5-7 business days. Full doc: https://docs.redwood.internal/q2-procurement-2026 :loudspeaker:
Kai (procurement): A few clarifications: 1) Delegated approvals still exist for low-risk SaaS <= $1,800/year (team lead sign-off). 2) Any vendor that touches customer data is excluded from delegation. 3) New vendors will need a vendor profile and tax_id before AP can pay.
Marta (ops): For travel-related subscriptions (expense management tools), do we treat them as recurring vendor entries?
Kai (procurement): Yes  include travel/expense platforms as recurring vendors if billed monthly. If you bill via corporate travel card, note the card name in the intake.
Ethan (eng): One quick thing: our infra team has a handful of small monitoring plugins billed $30-$60/mo via marketplace. Should those be listed?
Avery (finance): Yup  any external recurring line item regardless of amount. We want visibility to prevent surprises and consolidate vendor records.
travel-bot: Notice: corporate card policy updated at 08:00 UTC. New cap: $1,200 single-charge without prior approval.
Kai (procurement): Process tips: use the intake dropdowns (vendor_risk, handles_pii, contract_term) to speed reviews. If you're submitting many rows, attach a CSV and prefix the filename with your cost_center. Example filename: infra_vendor_export_2026-04.csv
Marta (ops): If a vendor requires faster onboarding for a live launch, what's the fastest path?
Kai (procurement): Mark the intake's "expedite" flag and post a short note in #help-procurement tagging @Kai. We'll triage but cannot guarantee under 48 hours for security checks. For payments, AP can do an exception if vendor_profile/tax_id exists.
Ethan (eng): Cool. Also, can procurement publish a stable mapping of vendor IDs so we can auto-tag our billing exports?
Kai (procurement): We're releasing a vendor-id CSV next week and a small API pilot later in Q2. For now stick to the canonical_vendor_id column on the intake sheet.
Avery (finance): Action items: teams, please add recurring vendors into the intake by 2026-04-07 COB; include owner_email and estimated monthly/annual spend; team leads be ready to approve delegated vendors. We'll run a sweep after the deadline and flag any missing records. Questions, post in #help-procurement. :memo:
